_doc: Full-year defector arrivals announced by South Korea's Ministry of Unification that the official data.go.kr PDF does not include yet. scripts/series/government.ts uses a year from here only until the PDF has it. Add a year with the announcement's URL.

years.note: Unification Ministry figures reported 2026-01-20: 224 people, cumulative 34,538. One outlet (SPN 서울평양뉴스) reported 223 with 25 men; the year-end official file will settle it.
